title: Restore the spend-ceiling banner dropped by the workspace rewrite
description:
Found while preparing chatticus-1d68fb.

#338 (6a9e97) added a workspace banner shown when GET /me reports computer_work_paused for the active org. Commit 3fb29a5 (#346, real workspace) removed it: web/components/EnabledWorkspace.tsx no longer references computer_work_paused, and only the MeOrganization type in web/lib/me.ts still carries the fields. A member past the ceiling gets refused turns with no explanation in the workspace.

Green at the API layer, broken at the UI seam. Restore the banner (with computer_work_paused_reason) in the new workspace layout, with a web test that renders it from a /me fixture. Blocks the 'member sees the banner' check in 1d68fb.

comments.author: home
comments.text: PR #368 restores the banner as its own component (ComputerPausedNotice), mounted between the conversation header and the error bar. Copy deliberately differs from #338: it no longer says an owner can raise the ceiling (no product control exists, 91f8f4); it says the workspace is still usable and to ask an operator. First real render test in the web suite (react-dom/server; tsx needs a test-only global React because tsconfig uses jsx: preserve). Mutation-checked: removing the mount from EnabledWorkspace fails the wiring test. Closing after merge and a live check on dev.
